Chapter 561 - 561 Equipment Arrived; Power Cut!

Chapter 561 - 561 Equipment Arrived; Power Cut!

561 Equipment Arrived; Power Cut!

Lin Fan had no idea about the change in Feng Zhixiang’s mentality.

At this moment, Lin Fan had already returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

His thoughts moved slightly.

In the next moment, a giant machine several meters tall appeared in the garden.

At the same time, a thick stack of documents appeared on the coffee table.

This was the controllable nuclear fusion equipment, as well as manuals, blueprints, and so on.

Although it was the first time he saw these things, Lin Fan knew every single component and function of this machine.

He sized it up for a while, then sat on the sofa and leisurely drank a few cups of Spirit Tea. He also played with his phone for a while.

Only then did she call Feng Zhixiang.

After the ringtone rang three times, the call was connected.

Just as Lin Fan was about to say something, a commotion sounded from inside.

“Director Feng, why is it so noisy over there?” he asked.”

“Oh, I’m at the airport. I’m going to Jingbei for a meeting. Professor Lin, is there anything you need?”

Lin Fan nodded. “The controllable nuclear fusion equipment has arrived at Coiling Dragon Villa. Since you’re going to Jingbei for a meeting, you can come back next time.”

…

Feng Zhixiang’s phone fell to the ground.

Then, he shouted at the top of his lungs, “Driver, driver! Make a turn! I’m not taking the plane anymore! I want to go to Coiling Dragon Villa!”

Then, Feng Zhixiang put the phone to his ear and said, “I’ll come over now. Professor Lin, please wait for me.”

After saying that, he hurriedly hung up the phone.

…

Lin Fan heard the busy tone on his phone and chuckled.

About ten minutes later, an Audi slammed on the brakes.

Feng Zhixiang walked down anxiously.

When he saw the huge machine that was several meters tall, his mouth opened wide, and he circled it a few times.

Then, he asked in an extremely excited voice, “Professor Lin… This is…”

Lin Fan nodded and said, “This is the controllable nuclear fusion device. I call it Ordinary 1.”

“Good name, good name!” Feng Zhixiang shouted excitedly.

As he spoke, he pressed his entire body against the device, as if he wanted to give it a big hug.

At this moment, three army helicopters approached from afar and slowly landed.

The leader of the soldiers saluted Feng Zhixiang and Lin Fan.

Then, he ordered a dozen soldiers to surround the controllable nuclear fusion equipment, as well as the gates and blind spots of the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan could not help but ask curiously, “Director Feng, why did you bring so many people here?”

“We just mentioned controllable nuclear fusion on the phone,” Feng Zhixiang said seriously. “If someone was eavesdropping, there’d be a certain risk!”

Lin Fan opened his mouth.

He wanted to say that no one in this world could eavesdrop on his phone.

However, he looked at Feng Zhixiang’s serious expression.

He swallowed his words back into his heart.

Forget it, forget it.

He could do whatever he wanted.

Lin Fan shook his head and continued playing with his phone.

Not long after, two green trucks and several large cranes drove into Coiling Dragon Villa.

After a series of careful maneuvering, the controllable nuclear fusion device finally landed smoothly on the truck.

Seeing this…

Feng Zhixiang could not help but nod his head. He turned to Lin Fan and said, “Professor Lin, let’s go.”

“Huh?” Lin Fan was stunned. “Leave? Where are we going?”

Feng Zhixiang said, “Of course, we’ll test the functions of Ordinary 1. Although I’ve already asked a group of experts to wait at Ordinary Technology Company, we still don’t know how to operate it.”

Lin Fan nodded helplessly.

Hence, Lin Fan drove the Cullinan to the outskirts of the city, where Ordinary Technology Company was.

At that moment, a large group of white-haired elders wearing glasses were standing at the entrance.

They… They were the experts that Feng Zhixiang had mentioned.

“Hello, Department Director Feng,” the experts said in unison.

Feng Zhixiang nodded.

Then, he introduced them to Professor Lin Fan.

Everyone’s figures became solemn.

Who in the entire academic world had not heard of Lin Fan’s name?

He was a great existence who had won four Nobel Prizes at the same time!

“Hello, Professor Lin.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Hello.”

Under Feng Zhixiang and Lin Fan’s instructions, the equipment was finally placed in the workshop in the middle.

Finally, a bald expert could not help but ask, “Professor Lin, what kind of equipment is this?”

Even though Feng Zhixiang had informed them to come over, he did not say what they were here for.

Obviously, this was also to prevent the phone from being tapped or the news from being leaked.

Lin Fan said, “Oh, this, Ordinary 1…”

Lin Fan thought about it and felt that no one had heard of the name Ordinary 1.

“It’s a controllable nuclear fusion device.”

His answer was very dull

However…

It sounded like a huge thunder in everyone’s ears, causing the entire workshop to suddenly fall silent.

A controllable nuclear fusion device?

The thing that only existed in legends?

“Everyone should know the rules,” Feng Zhixiang said solemnly. “I won’t say much. Later, everyone must sign a confidentiality agreement!”

Everyone nodded.

Then, Feng Zhixiang said in a very nervous and anxious tone, “Professor Lin, what should we do next?”

Lin Fan said, “Have you prepared the deuterated water?”

“It’s ready!” Feng Zhixiang said.

Before building Ordinary Technology, Lin Fan had told him that he would be able to use controllable nuclear fusion technology.

Therefore, Feng Zhixiang had someone refine tritium early on.

The purpose… was to test the controllable nuclear fusion faster.

Lin Fan nodded. “Although our factory is big, the power consumption is too low. Even the smallest amount of energy is enough to burn all the electrical equipment.”

“How about this? Contact the electricity department and ask Lake District and Summer District to cut off electricity for two hours.”

Feng Zhixiang responded like a soldier, “Alright!”

Then, he quickly made a call.

“Leader Jiao, hello. I have an urgent matter here. I need your cooperation…”

Not long after Feng Zhixiang hung up, his phone vibrated slightly.

“Professor Lin, Lake District and Summer District is having a power cut,” Feng Zhixiang said.

Lin Fan pointed at the entrance not far away and said, “Pour a ton of deuterium here.”

Under Feng Zhixiang’s command, someone quickly injected the tritium into it.

Lin Fan said, “Alright, everything is ready. I will start.”

Hence…

Under the watchful eyes of Feng Zhixiang and the experts, Lin Fan fiddled with many complicated buttons on the dashboard.

“Activate!”

After saying that, he pressed the last red button.
